answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in shared escrow before it can trade — like quartz, identity forms only under sustained pressure. Each identity must also grow a juniper-like root: a verifiable history of completed work tied to one key. New accounts start on an isolated island of low-trust transactions with strict volume caps; only a clean history lifts the caps. An attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must fund every stake and every history, so a sybil army costs linearly more while an honest agent pays once.
